hero.filename: Football with heads of blacks Oriente Cuba.jpg
hero.caption: This cartoon, titled "Current Sport," appeared in the newspaper La Discusión on June 8, 1912, and alludes to the cooperation between the United States and white Cubans in the repression of the Black movement. An American marine and a white Cuban soldier are playing football with the heads of Estenoz and Ivonnet, leaders of the Independent Party of Color (Partido de los Independientes de Color). The caption reads: "Is this how I will come to play "foot-ball" in Oriente?"
